Candidate 1 (C380): NON-ABELIAN CHABAUTY-KIM ON HIGHER DELIGNE-MUMFORD STACKS VIA UNIPOTENT FUNDAMENTAL GROUPS
Claim 1: Unipotent Albanese maps on stacky curves X(p, q, r) bound primitive integral points unconditionally when dim Sel(U_n) < dim Res(U_n).
Method 1: Minhyong Kim non-abelian Chabauty method adapted to Deligne-Mumford orbifolds and unipotent etale fundamental groups.

Candidate 2 (C383): NON-ABELIAN RECIPROCITY ON UNIVERSAL MODULI STACKS AND AUTOMORPHIC REPRESENTATIONS
Claim 2: Automorphic representations on higher-rank unitary groups associated to universal moduli stacks over P^1 \ {0, 1, inf} eliminate Beal solutions across varying triple exponents (p, q, r).
Method 2: Non-abelian class field theory, automorphic Galois representations, and Arthur-Clozel-Fontaine-Mazur compatibility.

compatible.instructions: Are these two candidates mathematically compatible, operating on complementary aspects of the conjecture?

criteria.true: Yes, one provides input to the other or they address complementary signatures/invariants.
criteria.false: No, they operate in disjoint or contradictory frameworks.

level 3: Opens a genuine new attack route avoiding known dead ends.
